observed.caption: Two tall towers rise behind a low commercial building with shops and trees under an overcast sky.
observed.description: The photo shows an outdoor urban street scene with a low, multi-story commercial building in the foreground and two taller high-rise towers behind it, one rectangular on the left and one cylindrical with a vertical glass shaft on the right. The foreground building has a textured facade, rows of windows, and ground-floor shops with signage, with green trees in front and along the sidewalk. Several pedestrians are visible at street level near the shops and sidewalk, and a blue and yellow bus is on the right side of the street. The sky is heavily overcast with gray clouds, and the lighting is diffused daylight.
